entities.summary: Clifford John Barton was an American professional ice hockey right winger. He was born in Michigan but moved to Port Arthur, Ontario, at an early age. Barton played three seasons in the National Hockey League (NHL) for the Pittsburgh Pirates, Philadelphia Quakers, and New York Rangers between 1929 and 1940. The rest of his career was spent in different minor leagues.
